newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to act on Nomura after seeing reports.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to act on Nomura after seeing reports.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry will decide what steps to take against Nomura Securities after receiving a report from the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told reporters on Tuesday.
"We would like to deal with the issue from the basic stance that we will consider strict measures after receiving a report from the SESC," he said after a regular cabinet meeting.
Nomura said last week that two of its directors were involved in suspected illegal deals.
Mitsuzuka also said that he hoped to settle a dispute over interest rates paid on the deposits MOF holds for the Welfare Ministry within this week.
He added that the cabinet ministers approved bills to revise the Bank of Japan law and bills to create a financial supervisory agency.
